objective: Descubrir la fuente canonica existente para actividad comercial por cliente necesaria por Customer360: debe permitir relacionar ClienteID con fecha operativa y monto/venta sin duplicar catalogos ni usar KPIs agregados sin cliente. Solo discovery SQL de metadatos y definiciones; no modificar vistas, tablas, codigo ni Produccion.

queries.name: g4e_r3_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS user_name

queries.name: g4e_r3_objects_with_clienteid
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(c.name)='clienteid') ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: g4e_r3_objects_cliente_fecha
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(c.name)='clienteid') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%fecha%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: g4e_r3_objects_cliente_operational_date
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(c.name)='clienteid') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=o.object_id AND (LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%fecha%oper%' OR LOWER(c.name) IN ('fechaoperacion','fecha_operacion','fecha_operativa'))) ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: g4e_r3_objects_cliente_amount
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(c.name)='clienteid') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=o.object_id AND (LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%total%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%venta%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%importe%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%monto%')) ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: g4e_r3_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND (o.name IN ('Venta_Encabezado','Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto','Sync_Ticket_Perfecto','Sync_Ventas_Historicas','RRR_Eventos') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns x WHERE x.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(x.name)='clienteid') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns y WHERE y.object_id=o.object_id AND (LOWER(y.name) LIKE '%fecha%oper%' OR LOWER(y.name) IN ('fechaoperacion','fecha_operacion','fecha_operativa'))))) ORDER BY s.name,o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_r3_candidate_view_definitions
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,OBJECT_DEFINITION(o.object_id) AS definition FROM sys.views o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name IN ('Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto','vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_Customer360') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns x WHERE x.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(x.name)='clienteid') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns y WHERE y.object_id=o.object_id AND (LOWER(y.name) LIKE '%fecha%oper%' OR LOWER(y.name) IN ('fechaoperacion','fecha_operacion','fecha_operativa')))) ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: g4e_r3_object_row_counts_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS object_name,p.rows AS approx_rows FROM sys.objects o LEFT JOIN (SELECT object_id,SUM(rows) AS rows FROM sys.partitions WHERE index_id IN (0,1) GROUP BY object_id) p ON p.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.name IN ('Venta_Encabezado','Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto','Sync_Ticket_Perfecto','Sync_Ventas_Historicas','RRR_Eventos') ORDER BY o.name
